name: MR-1 medium + acetate + N2O (PMC9381517)
description: MR-1 medium + acetate + N2O — medium reported in PMC9381517, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC9381517 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification: paper-verified (complete recipe; cited + supplementary sources chased)
provenance.verification_evidence: Sodium acetate was added to a concentration of 5.0 mM as the sole source of electrons and carbon.
provenance.base_medium: Modified MR-1 (Shewanella) phosphate-buffered mineral medium of Yoon, Sanford & Loffler 2013 AEM (ref 31); pH ~7.0, phosphate-buffered, N2-flushed with trace N2O as electron acceptor

sources_chased.what: Table S1 (1000X trace metal solution) + Table S2 (1000X vitamin stock) in the paper's own Supplementary Information (41396_2022_1260_MOESM1_ESM.docx)
sources_chased.how: EuropePMC supplementaryFiles zip -> extracted DOCX word/document.xml

sources_chased.what: base-medium reference 31 (Yoon, Sanford & Loffler 2013 AEM, PMC3623185) to confirm the MR-1 mineral base and its N/P/salt scheme
added: confirmed phosphate-buffered basal salts (NaCl, NH4Cl, KH2PO4, K2HPO4) + trace metal + vitamin stock design

missing_before: All 9 vitamins (4-aminobenzoic acid, D-biotin, nicotinic acid, Ca-pantothenate, pyridoxine-HCl, folic acid, alpha-lipoic acid, thiamine-HCl, cyanocobalamine/B12)
Trace elements Ni (NiCl2), Se (H2SeO3), B (H3BO3), Mo (Na2MoO4), W (Na2WO4), Al (AlK(SO4)x)
Explicit identities/concentrations of the Fe, Mn, Zn, Cu, Co, Ca trace-metal salts (previously only generic ions)
recuration.notes: Complete recipe recovered from the paper's own Supplementary Tables S1 (trace metals) and S2 (vitamins); both are 1000X stocks added at 1 mL per L, so listed final concentrations are stock amount/100 mL divided by 100. NOTE: the recipe contains NO magnesium salt (neither the base nor Table S1 includes Mg), so the 'Magnesium (Mg2+, from trace metal solution)' entry in the prior current_components is spurious and should be dropped. Culture was microaerobic (dissolved O2 could not be reduced below ~10 uM) but effectively N2-flushed with trace N2O (~200 ppmv) as the terminal electron acceptor; no

components.mapping_note: [CHEM-B12-01] cbl1 is Cob(I)alamin, the transient reduced Co(I) intracellular redox state of the cofactor -- it is not a dietary or medium B12 species. Cyanocobalamin (C63H88CoN14O14P) has no in_biggr BiGG id (b12 carries no formula and no InChIKey and is absent from BiGGr). adocbl (Adenosylcobalamin, C72H100CoN18O17P, ZIHHMGTYZOSFRC-QRVZQHAISA-N) is a real dietary/coenzyme B12 form present in BiGGr and is recorded as a declared proxy for the vitamer group, not as an exact identity.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
